body.name: Full-record conditional target and sharp interval
body.construction: For every \(x_{0:T}\in\mathcal S^{T+1}\) with \(\rho(x_0)\prod_{t=1}^T P(x_t\mid x_{t-1},b(x_{t-1}))>0\), define \(Q^{\mathrm{full}}_{q,T}(x_{0:T})=\mathbb E_{q,\rho,b,\pi}[T^{-1}\sum_{t=1}^T r(Z_t)\mid X_{0:T}=x_{0:T}]\), \(I^{\mathrm{full}}_T(P,\rho,b,x_{0:T})=\{Q^{\mathrm{full}}_{q,T}(x_{0:T}):q\in\Theta(P)\}\), and \(D^{\mathrm{full}}_T(P,\rho,b,x_{0:T})=\sup I^{\mathrm{full}}_T(P,\rho,b,x_{0:T})-\inf I^{\mathrm{full}}_T(P,\rho,b,x_{0:T})\).
